description: This file defines the Styles class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for reading style information from Gnumeric spreadsheet files. It handles parsing style ranges, border styles, fill patterns, alignment, fonts, and color information, and applies these styles to the active sheet in a Spreadsheet object.

classes.name: Styles
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and applying style information from Gnumeric spreadsheet files to a Spreadsheet object within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Styles object with a Spreadsheet instance and a flag indicating whether to read data only.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads style definitions from an XML element representing a sheet and applies styles up to specified maximum row and column.

methods.name: readStyles
methods.description: Parses style regions from the XML and applies styles to the specified cell ranges.

methods.name: addBorderDiagonal
methods.description: Adds diagonal border styles to the style array based on XML attributes.

methods.name: addBorderStyle
methods.description: Adds a specific border style (top, bottom, left, right) from XML to the style array.

methods.name: calcRotation
methods.description: Calculates text rotation degree based on XML style attributes.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Maps a style value to its internal constant and adds it to style array.

methods.name: addStyle2
methods.description: Helper for addStyle, mapping nested style keys.

methods.name: parseBorderAttributes
methods.description: Parses border attributes, including color and style, from XML.

methods.name: parseGnumericColour
methods.description: Converts Gnumeric color string to RGB hex format.

methods.name: addColors
methods.description: Adds font and fill color information to style array based on XML attributes.

methods.name: readStyleRange
methods.description: Determines the cell range covered by a style region based on XML attributes and maximum row/column.

methods.name: readStyle
methods.description: Reads style details from XML and constructs an array of style properties to be applied.
